title: The Quiet Authority, Stillness Journey (Video 8, the original)

spotlight_candle.note: The spotlight, jar and candle from the Version 8 opening, old text removed.

character_spotlight.note: The seated figure in the spotlight from the Version 8 'Be still' scene, old text removed.

music.note: The music from the Version 8 video, continued to 8 minutes. Any video up to 11,520 frames can use it.

scripture.text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

teaching_blocks.reflection: Stillness is not empty. It is full of Him.

scripture.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

teaching_blocks.reflection: He is not asking for your strength.

scripture.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

teaching_blocks.reflection: Peace does not come from understanding everything.

scripture.text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

teaching_blocks.reflection: What you carry in your heart shapes your life.

scripture.text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

teaching_blocks.reflection: Stop chasing what He has already promised to add.

scripture.text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

teaching_blocks.reflection: Waiting on God is not weakness. It is war.

scripture.text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved. For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

closing.prayer: Father, I thank You that You are my Anchor of Faithfulness. Forgive me for the times I have slipped into performative noise, thinking I had to scream or use the perfect words to be heard. I choose right now to shut the door on the frantic demands of this world and rest in the secret place of Your presence. Thank You that You intimately know my needs before I even speak. Settle my mind, clear away the weight of heavy burdens, and teach me to walk out into the marketplace with Your unshakeable peace. I lean entirely on Your blueprint, not my own strength. In Jesus' name, Amen.
